queries: WITH per_obs AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM per_obs) SELECT AVG(p.telescope_count * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(p.share) AS avg_share, AVG(p.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_above_average FROM per_obs p CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE p.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (observatories with no telescopes are excluded), so the average share across observatories is taken over observatories that have at least one telescope.
Share is the observatory's telescope count divided by the total telescope count, expressed as a fraction (0-1), not a percentage.
'How far on average their share sits above the average share' is the mean of (share - overall average share) over the above-average observatories.

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in telescopes (observstation); observatories with zero telescopes are not included in the average share baseline.

Share is the observatory's telescope count divided by the total telescope count; the 'average share across all observatories' is the unweighted mean of those shares (equal to 1/number of observatories).
'How far on average their share sits above the average share' is the mean of (share - overall average share) among the above-average observatories.
